 The USS Theodore Roosevelt has arrived in the Middle East, while Iran warned it would not simply wait for an attack. 
 People gather to look at the USS Theodore Roosevelt in Gosport, England. [File:Dan Kitwood/Getty Images] By Kristina Harazim and Leena Fraihat Published On 16 Nov 2026 16 Nov 2026 Save

 The USS Theodore Roosevelt has arrived in the Middle East, a US official told Al Jazeera. The aircraft carrier joins two others operating in the US Central Command area.
 Kazem Gharibabadi, Iran’s deputy foreign minister for legal and international affairs, says Tehran “will not wait for the US to attack first” and suggests Washington might be buying time through diplomacy to prepare for another attack.
